release.indexCompatibility: Only current generator-v17 snapshots are retrievable; rebuild earlier publications explicitly.

summary: Inspect and reclaim external Shin snapshot payloads under one explicit cache root without scanning consumer repositories or deleting unverified data.

list.name: index-list
list.strictPolicy: Exit 1 when a verified incompatible snapshot, corrupt managed snapshot, or unsafe immediate entry remains. Unmanaged files and already-pruned empty shells are reported but do not make the cache dirty.

prune.name: index-prune
prune.strictPolicy: Dry-run strict fails while eligible candidates remain. Apply strict succeeds only when every selected prune completed and no corrupt, unsafe, missing-protection, or protected-incompatible condition remains.

cacheBoundary.selection: --cache-dir is mandatory. Global --profile, --profile-dir, --root, --out-dir, --from-index, and --source-scan are rejected.
cacheBoundary.pathPolicy: The root must already exist, must not itself be a symlink, is canonicalized before use, and must not resolve to the filesystem root.
cacheBoundary.enumeration: Only at most 4096 immediate children are inspected. Core does not discover cache roots, consumer repositories, adoption markers, or active keys.
cacheBoundary.managedKey: A candidate directory name must satisfy the portable index identifier contract. An index is managed only when docs/kb/generated/manifest.json exists.
cacheBoundary.unmanagedPolicy: Non-index files, invalid keys, empty shells, and unsupported layouts are reported. They are never selected for deletion.

inspection.verification: Every managed snapshot acquires its shared index lock and passes the complete VerifiedSnapshot manifest, integrity-table, physical-tree, path, hash, size, and row metadata checks before lifecycle classification.
inspection.compatibility: current means generator_version exactly equals the running binary generator. A different verified generator is incompatible-generator, not a readable fallback.
inspection.sizeAccounting: snapshot_bytes is the verified manifest plus every integrity-table file. Control locks and empty directory shells are excluded.

prunePolicy.defaultCandidates: Verified incompatible-generator snapshots not protected by --keep-key.
prunePolicy.unreferencedCandidates: --prune-unreferenced additionally selects verified current snapshots not protected by --keep-key and is rejected unless at least one keep key is supplied.
prunePolicy.protection: At most 256 unique portable --keep-key values may be supplied. A protected key is never pruned, including when its generator is incompatible.
prunePolicy.missingProtection: If any requested keep key is absent from the selected cache root, the command fails and performs no candidate selection or mutation regardless of --strict.
prunePolicy.deletionScope: Apply removes only the selected output root's docs/kb/generated payload and freshness cache. The output shell and lock files remain for a safe later rebuild.
prunePolicy.toctouBoundary: Apply reacquires writer, index, and freshness locks in the established order and compares the exact inspected manifest bytes before deleting the generated payload.
prunePolicy.diagnostics: Every candidate action records reason, snapshot identity, generator, bytes, apply request, applied status, and any failure. A partial multi-index operation retains all completed action evidence.

ownership.core: Owns bounded enumeration, snapshot verification, compatibility classification, dry-run planning, locking, manifest identity recheck, and generated-payload removal.
ownership.agentOrOperator: Owns the explicit cache root, active marker-derived keep keys, whether unreferenced pruning is intended, and the final --apply decision.
ownership.consumer: Consumer repositories are neither scanned nor mutated. Adoption markers remain the authority for active index keys.

nonGoals: No age-based eviction, LRU policy, quota daemon, or hidden cache discovery.
No deletion of arbitrary directories or corrupt data.
No migration or conversion of pre-v15 snapshots.
No inference of active keys from running processes or neighboring repositories.
No removal of lock shells after payload reclamation.

requiredEvidence: deterministic inventory of current, incompatible, corrupt, empty, unsafe, and unmanaged entries
strict inventory failure without non-strict diagnostic failure
dry-run by default and explicit apply
missing protected keys block every apply action even without --strict
unreferenced pruning requires a keep-key safeguard
corrupt and symlink entries survive apply
only generated payload and freshness data are removed
cache-root symlink, filesystem root, and global route options fail closed
portable M4 and Linux AMD64 execution under ASan/UBSan
